text:
This airplane window has a hole in it!
Looks like a mistake. I'll plug it.

speaker: fitz
text:
There are three panes. The outer one holds the cabin pressure.
But the middle one is the backup. It shouldn't be working yet.
So this tiny hole lets cabin air into the gap. Equal pressure on both sides, so the middle pane rests.

speaker: gauge
text: But what if the outer one cracks?

speaker: fitz
text: The rested middle pane takes over. Rare, but planned for.

speaker: gauge
text: Ooh, what else is built weird? Subscribe and let's find out.
